plainLanguage: Pearland builds to the 2021 International Residential Code with local amendments, the 2021 energy code and the 2023 electrical code. If your lot is in the Brazoria County part of Pearland, the state requires a windstorm inspection and certificate (WPI-8) from the Texas Department of Insurance in addition to the city permit; lots in the Harris or Fort Bend parts do not. Your floor must be at least 1 foot above the 100-year flood level or at the 500-year flood level, whichever is higher, and an attached garage floor too. The city building permit is about $0.41 per square foot, and water/sewer impact fees were about $9,600 in 2023. Most new subdivisions are planned developments with their own setback and material rules, so check your plat and HOA rules.
